ns2:course.label: Introduction to NPRE Heat Transfer
ns2:course.description: Engineering principles in heat and mass transfer with emphasis on applications in NPRE will be covered. Specifically, the focus in this course will be on heat conduction, convection, radiation, and boiling. Prerequisite: MATH 285; credit or concurrent registration in TAM 335 or ME 310.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 285; credit or concurrent registration in TAM 335 or ME 310.
